name: NASN Intelligent Tech (Zhejiang) Co., Ltd.
summary: NASN Intelligent Tech (Zhejiang) Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacturing, development, and sells of driving motion control technologies in China, Southeast Asia, and South America. The company's products include NBC, an integrated intelligent braking system; ESC, a vehicle stability control system; NBooster, an electric braking assist system; a drive-by-wire chassis solution that supports L3/L4; and DP-EPS, a dual pinion steer-by-wire system. It also offers brake-by-wire solutions for intelligent driving, sensing, computing, and control technologies that enable vehicles to assist or automate driving functions to improve safety, comfort, and efficiency.
